_: The generic filling of the slots in og-invite.html and og-live.html — what scripts/gen-app-icons.mjs cuts into the committed og-*.png. Those PNGs are the DEGRADATION path: with per-trip covers the backend draws the real trip, and it falls back to these bytes only when a render fails or there is no built PWA to read the CSS from. So this text stands in for a trip it could not draw and must name none. The backend never reads this file; it always has real facts.
